cases.name: a single load writes one row: reason, bytes, tokens, path, session
cases.cmd: R={{FIX}}/ctx-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $R/.claude/hooks; cp .claude/hooks/context-log.sh $R/.claude/hooks/; printf 'rule body\n' > $R/rule.md; printf '%s' '{"reason":"startup","session_id":"abcdef123456","file_path":"'$R'/rule.md"}' | bash $R/.claude/hooks/context-log.sh; cat $R/.claude/context-log.tsv

cases.name: a load carrying a list writes one row per file
cases.cmd: R={{FIX}}/ctx-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $R/.claude/hooks; cp .claude/hooks/context-log.sh $R/.claude/hooks/; printf 'rule body\n' > $R/rule.md; cp $R/rule.md $R/second.md; printf '%s' '{"reason":"lazy","session_id":"s1","files":["'$R'/rule.md","'$R'/second.md"]}' | bash $R/.claude/hooks/context-log.sh; printf 'rows=%s' "$(wc -l < $R/.claude/context-log.tsv | tr -d ' ')"

cases.name: a payload with no path is logged as such rather than dropped
cases.cmd: R={{FIX}}/ctx-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $R/.claude/hooks; cp .claude/hooks/context-log.sh $R/.claude/hooks/; printf 'rule body\n' > $R/rule.md; printf '%s' '{"reason":"import","session_id":"s1"}' | bash $R/.claude/hooks/context-log.sh; cat $R/.claude/context-log.tsv

cases.name: the agent id fills the last column and stays empty on the main chain
cases.cmd: R={{FIX}}/ctx-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $R/.claude/hooks; cp .claude/hooks/context-log.sh $R/.claude/hooks/; printf 'rule body\n' > $R/rule.md; printf '%s' '{"reason":"startup","session_id":"s1","agent_id":"agent999","file_path":"'$R'/rule.md"}' | bash $R/.claude/hooks/context-log.sh; printf '%s' '{"reason":"startup","session_id":"s1","file_path":"'$R'/rule.md"}' | bash $R/.claude/hooks/context-log.sh; awk -F'\t' '{printf "[%s]", $7}' $R/.claude/context-log.tsv

cases.name: the first payload is kept raw, the schema not being documented
cases.cmd: R={{FIX}}/ctx-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $R/.claude/hooks; cp .claude/hooks/context-log.sh $R/.claude/hooks/; printf 'rule body\n' > $R/rule.md; printf '%s' '{"reason":"startup","session_id":"s1","file_path":"'$R'/rule.md"}' | bash $R/.claude/hooks/context-log.sh; printf '%s' '{"reason":"second","session_id":"s1","file_path":"'$R'/rule.md"}' | bash $R/.claude/hooks/context-log.sh; cat $R/.claude/context-log.raw.json

cases.name: a path the load names but the disk does not have is logged at zero bytes
cases.cmd: R={{FIX}}/ctx-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $R/.claude/hooks; cp .claude/hooks/context-log.sh $R/.claude/hooks/; printf 'rule body\n' > $R/rule.md; printf '%s' '{"reason":"startup","session_id":"s1","file_path":"'$R'/gone.md"}' | bash $R/.claude/hooks/context-log.sh; cat $R/.claude/context-log.tsv

cases.name: malformed input observes nothing and never blocks
cases.cmd: R={{FIX}}/ctx-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $R/.claude/hooks; cp .claude/hooks/context-log.sh $R/.claude/hooks/; printf 'not json' | bash $R/.claude/hooks/context-log.sh; n=$(wc -l < $R/.claude/context-log.tsv 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' '); printf 'rows=%s' "${n:-0}"

cases.name: an empty payload exits 0
cases.cmd: R={{FIX}}/ctx-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $R/.claude/hooks; cp .claude/hooks/context-log.sh $R/.claude/hooks/; printf 'rule body\n' > $R/rule.md; printf '{}' | bash $R/.claude/hooks/context-log.sh
